description: This file defines a TimeoutManager class used for managing timeouts during test execution, including handling different test phases, fixtures, and error reporting.

classes.name: TimeoutManager
classes.description: Manages test timeouts, including setting, ignoring, and handling timeout errors during test execution.

classes.name: TimeoutManagerError
classes.description: Custom error class for timeout-related errors.

methods.name: setIgnoreTimeouts
methods.description: Sets the manager to ignore all timeouts.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Interrupts the current running test by rejecting its timeout promise.

methods.name: isTimeExhaustedFor
methods.description: Checks if the allotted time for a given runnable has been exhausted.

methods.name: withRunnable
methods.description: Runs a given asynchronous callback within a managed timeout context.

methods.name: _updateTimeout
methods.description: Updates the timeout for the current running test or fixture.

methods.name: slow
methods.description: Increases the timeout duration for the current test to three times the original.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a new timeout duration for the current test or fixture.

methods.name: currentSlotDeadline
methods.description: Returns the deadline timestamp for the current slot.

methods.name: currentSlotType
methods.description: Returns the type of the current slot (e.g., 'test').

methods.name: _createTimeoutError
methods.description: Creates a detailed timeout error message based on the current runnable context.
